knowledge.elder: The elder said round things roll. You can now chisel stone disks.
knowledge.kid: The village kid owns a perfectly round rock. Kids just have stuff.
knowledge.boulder: The boulder is round. It rolls. You've been looking at this wrong.
knowledge.painting: Your cave painting of a wheel will confuse archaeologists for 5,000 years.
knowledge.shortcut: There's a shortcut to the forest behind the latrine. Chopping is faster from there.
knowledge.prayer: The Great Circle does not answer prayers. It is busy being round.

tasks.name: Gather stones
tasks.text: You gather two stones. They are not round. Yet.

tasks.name: Sharpen a rock
tasks.text: You hit a rock with a rock until one of them is pointy.

tasks.name: Chop a tree with your bare hands
tasks.text: You karate-chop a tree for sixteen seconds. It works, somehow.

tasks.name: Chop a tree with the sharp rock
Take the latrine shortcut and chop
tasks.text: It smells terrible, but you're efficient now.

tasks.name: Ask the elder for advice
tasks.text: The elder mumbles: 'Round things... roll. I saw it once. In a dream. Or a mushroom.'

tasks.name: Play with the village kid
tasks.text: The kid shows you their favorite toy: a perfectly round rock. You stare at it for a long time.

tasks.name: Borrow the kid's round rock
tasks.text: 'Borrow' is a strong word. The kid is crying. You'll give it back after the apocalypse.

tasks.name: Chisel a stone disk
tasks.text: Chip, chip, chip. It's... roughly round. Roundish. Round-adjacent.

tasks.name: Assemble the cart and flee
tasks.text: You bolt two disks onto an axle, slap a log on top, and roll away just as the boulder hits. You have invented the wheel. And the getaway.

tasks.name: Stare at the boulder
tasks.text: It's coming down the ridge. It is extremely round. It is rolling. A thought begins to form.

tasks.name: Ride the boulder
tasks.text: You leap onto the boulder as it arrives. It rolls. You roll with it, balancing on top. You have invented the wheel, the unicycle, and extreme sports. It was the boulder. It was always the boulder.

tasks.name: Wander behind the latrine
tasks.text: You find a shortcut to the forest. You also find out why nobody goes back here.

tasks.name: Invent fire (unrelated)
tasks.text: You invent fire. Huge, honestly. Not what you were supposed to be doing, though.

tasks.name: Paint a wheel on the cave wall
tasks.text: By firelight you paint a perfect circle. It is beautiful. It does not help with the boulder at all.

tasks.name: Pray to the Great Circle
tasks.text: You pray. Nothing happens. In the distance, the boulder rumbles, unbothered.

tasks.name: Take a nap
tasks.text: You dream of circles. Ten seconds gone. Worth it?

tasks.name: Just run
tasks.text: You run. The boulder is faster. Boulders are always faster.

deaths: The boulder arrives. You are now a very flat caveman.
SQUISH. The village is now a pancake. A round pancake, at least.
The boulder rolls over you, your village, and your hopes. It doesn't even slow down.
Flattened. As you become two-dimensional, you notice the boulder's shape. Interesting...
The boulder wins. Again. It has never lost.
loopStarts: You wake up. It's the same morning. The ground is already rumbling.
You wake up again. Your arms remember things your brain doesn't.
Same morning. Same rumble. Same elder, already mumbling about circles.
Loop #{n}. The kid waves at you. You wave back, already planning to steal their toy.
